evidence.quote: The following tuition fees apply for the 2026-2027 academic year.

notes: No documents were named for this programme. The programme page gives a Dutch-language tuition fee node in Dutch (wettelijk collegegeld / instellingscollegegeld) but no amount; the institutional fee used here comes from the institution-wide English page (€10,308 for 2026-2027), which is for bachelor's and master's degree students and applicable to non-EEA students. The deadline of 1 May for non-EEA applicants is mentioned in the tuition-fees page for the programme; the specific application deadline (year) is not shown on the supplied pages, so it is left out as a fixed date and treated as a manual check.

note.fr: Vérifiez les conditions d'admission : la page indique qu'il faut un diplôme havo, vwo ou mbo niveau 4, et 'Kijk bij de opleiding welke eisen voor jou van toepassing zijn'.
note.en: Check the admission requirements: the page states you need a havo, vwo or mbo level 4 diploma, and says to check the programme page for the requirements that apply to you.

evidence.quote: Dat kan alleen als je een havo-, vwo- of mbo niveau 4-diploma hebt.
Kijk bij de opleiding welke eisen voor jou van toepassing zijn.

note.fr: Pour les étudiants non-EEE, le 'studiekeuzecheck' (intake) est obligatoire.
note.en: For non-EEA students, the 'studiekeuzecheck' (intake) is compulsory.

evidence.quote: Voor NON-EER studenten is de studiekeuzecheck verplicht.

note.fr: Les étudiants de nationalité non-EEE doivent postuler avant le 1er mai et payer les frais de scolarité avant le début de l'année académique (paiement complet avant le 15 juin).
note.en: Students with a non-EEA nationality must apply by May 1st and pay tuition fees in full before the start of the academic year (full payment by June 15).

evidence.quote: Students with a non-EEA nationality are required to apply by May 1st and to pay their tuition fees in full prior to the start of the academic year.
If the full amount is not received by Avans University of Applied Sciences before June 15, your application will automatically be canceled.
